deadline.value: The department suggests applying by 5 January 2027 for October 2027 entry to its Mathematics PhD programmes, which include Statistics.
deadline.quote: We suggest prospective students apply by 5 January 2027 for studies commencing in October 2027 for all our Mathematics PhD programmes.

gre_subject.value: King's does not consider the GRE in its selection processes, so no GRE Subject test is used.
gre_subject.quote: Please note that at King's we do not consider the GRE in our selection processes.

supervisor.value: Written agreement from a supervisor is needed before the application can go forward.
supervisor.quote: You must receive written confirmation that your supervisor(s) have agreed to submit you before progressing with your application.

funding.value: All scholarships and awards are competitive; the Martingale Foundation scholarships fully cover fees and pay a stipend.
funding.quote: All scholarships, bursaries or other awards are offered on a competitive basis.

entry_route.value: A first or upper second-class degree in mathematics or a related subject is enough; no master's is stated.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should hold, or expect to gain, a first or upper second-class degree in mathematics or a relevant related subject, and be exceptionally motivated for research.

notes: The areas list also has a separate Biostatistics and Health Informatics Research PhD (LSM). It was not researched and is not saved here.
